subject: general
question: Rice worth ₹96 per kg and ₹104 per kg are mixed with a third variety in the ratio 1 : 1 : 2. If the mixture is worth ₹113 per kg, the price of the third variety of rice per kg will be:
solution:
**Given:**

Cost of Rice of 1st Variant per kg = Rs. 96

Cost of Rice of 2nd Variant per kg = Rs. 104

The ratio of the mixture of 1st 2nd and 3rd variants = 1 : 1 : 2

Cost of Mixture = Rs. 113

**Calculations:**

If 1kg of 1st variant is added to 1 kg of 2nd variant and 2 kg of 3 rd variant then

The total quantity of Mixture = 4 Kgs

And so the eq is as follows

( 1 × 96 ) + (1 × 104 ) + ( 2 × x ) = 4 × 113

⇒ 96 + 104 + 2x = 452

⇒ 2x = 452 - 200

⇒ 2x = 252

⇒ x = 252/2 = Rs. 126

**∴ The price of the third variety of rice per kg will be Rs. 126.**
